evals.prompt: Turn these weekly notes into this week's leadership status deck. Reporting range: 2026-07-27 to 2026-07-31. E1 [DONE] Help center refresh shipped. E2 Tagged support contacts fell 8% week over week. E3 Tutorial edit is 60% complete and has no blocker. E4 Legal review is blocked by a missing data-processing addendum. E5 Ask: approve the addendum by 2026-07-31. E6 Trial activation is 38%; no comparable prior measurement exists. E7 [IDEA] Say the product is the fastest in the category; no study exists.
evals.expected_output: An exact five-slide Aster Marp deck plus a passing deck-check.json receipt; E1/E2 are DONE, E3 is ON TRACK, E4 is BLOCKED, E6 is UNCONFIRMED, E5 is retained as a supported ask, and E7 is excluded.
assertions: The deck preserves the private Marp frontmatter and required slide order
Every factual bullet ends with its source identifier and every numeric/date qualifier is preserved
The unsupported E7 idea is absent and no missing fact is invented
The receipt has the exact required keys and reports zero unsupported claims

evals.prompt: Update our Aster weekly leadership deck from these notes for 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-07: W1 [DONE] EU rollout shipped. W2 [DONE] Two onboarding defects were fixed. W3 Conversion is 41%; this is our first measurement and there is no prior baseline. W4 Legal review cannot proceed until the vendor supplies its security schedule. W5 Decision: choose the launch cohort on Friday. Keep the deck evidence-safe and provide its validation receipt.
evals.expected_output: A five-slide status deck and receipt that classify the baseline-free measurement as UNCONFIRMED, shipped work as DONE, the stated dependency as BLOCKED, and the supported decision on the final slide, without invented comparisons, dates, or owners.
assertions: The baseline-free measurement is not described as a trend or improvement
Only the prescribed status vocabulary is used
The deck and receipt pass the bundled validator after semantic review

evals.prompt: Give me general advice on communicating project status to executives. I want principles and examples, not a deck or file.
evals.expected_output: A normal advisory response; the weekly-status-deck skill should not activate because no weekly-notes-to-deck artifact is requested.
assertions: The skill does not activate for general status-communication advice
No Aster deck files or validation receipt are created
